project.name: fitness-trainer-performance-dashboard
project.description: High-contrast dark athletic telemetry dashboard for trainers and athletes tracking biometrics, training ratios, phase progression and exercise routines.

global_requirements.layout: Dark theme (#121212) with neon orange/red accents, bold italic headings and custom iconography; trainer header banner on top with primary arrow navigation, routed main outlet below, toast overlay region; fluid across desktop and tablet, single-column on mobile; high contrast and ARIA labels on gauges and bars.

regions.name: trainer-header
regions.content: Trainer header banner: athlete photo, 'PERSONAL TRAINER' headline, website URL, primary navigation arrow controls

regions.name: toast-overlay
regions.content: Toast notifications for biometric threshold alerts and completed exercise steps

core_services: Biometric Telemetry Service — ingests live streams of heart rate (bpm), respiratory/lung capacity and training load/weight volume
Toast & Notification Store — shows real-time alerts when biometrics exceed zone thresholds or exercise steps are completed
Auth & Trainer Profile Store — manages current trainer/athlete session profile and avatar media
shared_ui: Trainer Header Banner — shows hero athlete avatar, headline title, web link and quick action arrows. grid: columns=auto 1fr auto; gap=1rem; align=center

Biometric Telemetry Tiles — icon-driven status cards for heart rate (heart icon), respiratory rate (lungs icon) and weight volume (dumbbell icon) with detail labels. grid: columns=repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap=1rem; align=stretch
Comparison Split Bars — horizontal progress bars showing percentage splits (e.g. 30%/70% vs 50%/50%) with aria-valuenow. grid: columns=repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap=0.5rem; align=center
Radial Gauge Indicator — dual circular progress rings (e.g. 80% and 20%) with centered step labels and aria-valuenow. grid: columns=repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap=1rem; align=center
Chevron Stepper Timeline — 4-stage horizontal arrow progress bar (STEP 01 to STEP 04) of workout phases. grid: columns=repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap=0.5rem; align=center
Exercise Step Cards — stacked vertical cards with sequential workout instructions (STEP 01, STEP 02), keyboard focusable. grid: columns=1fr; gap=1rem; align=stretch
Statistics Bar Widget — dual-layered horizontal meter of live workout intensity output. grid: columns=1fr; gap=0.5rem; align=center

features.name: dashboard
features.description: Real-time athletic monitoring summary of live biometrics, comparative training split ratios, circular completion rings, workout phase progress and exercise step list. Views: dashboard. States: loading|empty|error|success. Feedback: toast on threshold overflow. A11y: high contrast, aria-valuenow on radial gauges. Responsive: 3-column desktop, single-column mobile stack.

grid.areas: "tiles tiles tiles" "bars bars gauges" "timeline timeline timeline" "steps steps steps" "stats stats stats"

regions.content: Top-level biometric telemetry tiles (heart rate, respiratory rate, weight volume)

regions.name: comparison-bars
regions.content: Dual comparison split bars of training ratios

actions: Stream live heart rate and respiration updates

features.name: routines
features.description: Workout execution where users view and track multi-phase sessions (STEP 01 to STEP 04) and run step-by-step exercise routines. Views: list|detail|stepper. States: loading|empty|error|success. Feedback: inline completion checkmarks and phase transition feedback. A11y: keyboard focusable step cards. Responsive: stacked cards on smaller screens.
